items.title: Amazon GuardDuty adds optional threat detection rules for Runtime Monitoring
items.blurb: Amazon GuardDuty now supports optional detection rules for Runtime Monitoring. You can enable more than 50 Runtime Monitoring rules that help detect process, file, and network activity that might be routine in one environment but a sign of…

items.title: AWS IAM Identity Center now supports optimistic locking for users and groups in its identity store
items.blurb: IAM Identity Center helps you configure the single sign-on experience of your workforce to AWS accounts and applications.

items.title: Grok 4.7 is now available on Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US)
items.blurb: Amazon Bedrock now supports SpaceXAI Grok 4.7, a frontier model built for coding, agentic tasks, and knowledge work in AWS GovCloud (US).

items.title: Amazon Connect Customer Global Resiliency now provides business users visibility into resiliency readiness across linked Regions
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Customer Global Resiliency now provides a Global Resiliency page in the admin website, giving administrators a single place to review their Region switch readiness.

items.title: Amazon CloudWatch Omni is now available in additional AWS Regions
items.blurb: AWS announces that Amazon CloudWatch Omni is now available in eight additional AWS Regions.

items.title: EC2 Image Builder now integrates with ASG for faster image builds
